safetyBanner.unknown: Safety state unknown. Reaper couldn't reach the server to confirm whether deletion is on. Until it can, treat this as armed and check Policy → Deletion.
safetyBanner.unknownNoLink: Safety state unknown. Reaper couldn't reach the server to confirm whether deletion is on. Until it can, treat this as armed and check Policy → Deletion once you're in the app.
safetyBanner.recovery: Recovery mode is on. Deletion is held off. Turn it off and restart once you're back in.
safetyBanner.readOnly: Read-only. Reaper can look but can't remove anything. Turn deletion on in Policy → Deletion when you're ready.
safetyBanner.readOnlyNoLink: Read-only. Reaper can look but can't remove anything. You turn deletion on later, in Policy → Deletion.
safetyBanner.armed: Deletion is on. Reaper can remove media you approve, through Sonarr and Radarr.

conflict.shortfall: Reaper cannot tell whether Season {pruned_season} is watched more than Season {kept_season}, since {cause}. Season {kept_season} is kept because {because}. Left for you to decide instead of removing it.

conflict.counted: {pruned_watchers, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} watched Season {pruned_season}, more than watched Season {kept_season}, which Reaper is keeping because {because}. Left for you to decide instead of removing it.

because.keep_last: it is one of the newest seasons your rule keeps
